turns.prompt: There is a small Python package in /work/01M5JHWMQVSFSSBXANDQ4BB3VH/lt-c1-fix-bug-20261030T1650-run15b/slugkit. Run its tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from that directory, find the bug the failing test points at, fix it in the package code (do not change the tests), run the
turns.verify_out:
SHOW Ran 4 tests in 0.000s

OK
PASS
turns.reply:
The bug was an off-by-one in `slugify`. It cut the text to `max_len + 1` characters, so one extra character survived. For example, `"abc defgh"` with `max_len=4` returned `"abc-d"` instead of `"abc"`.

I changed the slice in `slugkit/slugkit/__init__.py` from `s[:max_len + 1]` to `s[:max_len]`. The tests are unchanged, and all 4 now pass with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` in `lt-c1-fix-bug-20261030T1650-run15b/slugkit`.
